Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem document. `code` is the stable machine-readable value; `type` is its URN.

adminBearerAuth.description: Admin API key (`rtr_admin_...`) or an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials access token. Basic and cookie credentials are rejected.

adminMutualTLS.description: mTLS client identity verified against the configured client CA snapshot; the certificate supplies the principal and any sender constraint.

info.description: Machine-to-machine admin control plane of the Metrum AI Router. Every operation is authorized by the Casbin authorizer in one decision per operation, rejects Basic, cookie and browser credentials, and answers errors as RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`. Concurrency: operations marked with `x-admin-concurrency: revision` require `If-Match` (428 when missing, 412 when stale) against the strong ETag `"rev-<configuration revision>"`; collections return `Link` `rel="next"` cursor pagination instead of an ETag. Idempotency: operations marked with `x-admin-idempotency` accept `Idempotency-Key` scoped to principal, domain and operation, retained 24 h and persisted, so a retry replays the original response and a different body on the same key answers 409. Response schemas are exact where a handler returns a typed value; handlers that still return an untyped object are documented as an open object whose description lists its members.
